title: Fourier coefficient bounded by influence
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\mathbb R$, and let $S$ be a set of coordinates containing $i$. Then the square of the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $S$ is at most the influence of coordinate $i$ on $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube
$S$ is a finite set of coordinates
